# COMMUNITY-ACQUIRED PNEUMONIA (CAP) TREATED WITH ORAL ANTIBIOTICS

Empirical regimens listed here cover the usual pathogens associated with CAP, including atypical pathogens. Specific therapy should be guided by culture results.

# Diagnosis

Use the CAP Pneumonia Severity Index (PSI) to assist with level of care decision
CAP Pneumonia Severity Index (PSI) Calculator

# Previously healthy patients (i.e. no comorbidities):

(WITHOUT chronic obstructive pulmonary disease, diabetes, renal failure, congestive heart failure, malignancy, alcoholism, asplenia, immunosuppressing conditions, or use of immunosuppressing drugs)

---

References:

- Metlay JP, Am J Respir Crit Care Med. 2019, 200(7):e45
- Sanford: Community Acquired Pneumonia
- Up-to-date website
Therapy:
Preferred:

Doxycycline 100 mg PO Q12H for 5 days DI

Non-VA order for above

< OR >
Amoxicillin 1000 mg PO Q8H for 5 days R

Non-VA order for above

## Patients with comorbidities:

(WITH chronic obstructive pulmonary disease, diabetes, renal failure, congestive
heart failure, malignancy, alcoholism, asplenia, immunosuppressing conditions or
use of immunosuppressing drugs)

Preferred:

Amoxicillin-clavulanate 875/125 mg PO Q12H for 5 days R <AND> azithromycin po
once on day 1, then 250 mg PO QDAY for 4 days [M]

Non-VA order for above

< OR >
Cefdinir 300 mg PO Q12H for 5 days R <AND> azithromycin once on day 1, then

250 mg PO QDAY for 4 days [M]

Non-VA order for above

< OR >
Amoxicillin-clavulanate 875/125 mg PO Q12H for 5 days R <AND> doxycycline 100
mg PO Q12H for 5 days [DI]

Non-VA order for above

< OR >
Cefdinir 300 mg PO q12h for 5 days R <AND> doxycycline 100 mg PO Q12H for 5
days [DI]

Non-VA order for above

## Alternative:

[Assessment of Beta-lactam Reaction](beta-lactam-allergy-assessment)

Levofloxacin 750 mg PO q24h for 5 days DI

Non-VA order for above
Inpt: ORZID3 GMENU CAP TREATED IN OUTPT SETTING
